root_cause.text: Incorrect bit field masks for the GENERIC_CMD register in the IPA v5.0+ GSI driver caused misconfiguration when writing command values, leading to a WARN during shutdown operations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes GENERIC_CHID mask from GENMASK(9,5) to GENMASK(12,5), GENERIC_EE from GENMASK(13,10) to GENMASK(16,13), and adds a missing GENERIC_PARAMS field with mask GENMASK(31,24). The commit message states that this "fixes a WARN I was seeing when I tried to send 'stop' to the MPSS remoteproc while IPA was up," and references matching the hardware layout from downstream documentation.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: Incorrect bit field masks for the GENERIC_CMD register in the IPA v5.0+ GSI driver caused misconfiguration when writing command values, leading to a WARN during shutdown operations.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes GENERIC_CHID mask from GENMASK(9,5) to GENMASK(12,5), GENERIC_EE from GENMASK(13,10) to GENMASK(16,13), and adds a missing GENERIC_PARAMS field with mask GENMASK(31,24). The commit message states that this "fixes a WARN I was seeing when I tried to send 'stop' to the MPSS remoteproc while IPA was up," and references matching the hardware layout from downstream documentation.

candidates.rationale: Declares the array containing the incorrect bit field masks that lead to misconfiguration.
Defines the mask for the GENERIC_OPCODE field; if the range is incorrect, it may misalign with later fields.
Defines the mask for GENERIC_CHID; an incorrect range can cause overlapping or reserved-bit writes.
Defines the mask for GENERIC_EE; an incorrect range can result in misconfiguration of the EE field.
Indicates reserved bits boundary; if masks exceed this, writing to reserved bits triggers a WARN during shutdown.

vuln_statements.explanation: Defines the mask for GENERIC_OPCODE with incorrect bit range (4:0) that does not match the expected field size, leading to misalignment with subsequent fields and potential WARN during shutdown when writing to reserved bits.

Defines the mask for GENERIC_CHID with incorrect bit range (9:5) that may overlap with reserved or other fields, causing misconfiguration when the command value is written and triggering a WARN during shutdown.
Defines the mask for GENERIC_EE with incorrect bit range (13:10) that may cause writing to reserved bits (14-31) or misalign with the intended field, leading to a WARN during shutdown operations.

Declares the array that holds the incorrect bit field masks for the GENERIC_CMD register. This array is used to apply masks during register writes, so any error in the masks propagates to the command value and causes misconfiguration.

Indicates that bits 14-31 are reserved. However, the preceding GENMASK definitions may inadvertently extend into these reserved bits, causing the hardware to WARN during shutdown when writing non-zero values to reserved bits.

Author: Alex Elder <elder@kernel.org>

    net: ipa: add IPA v5.0 GSI register definitions
    
    Add the definitions of GSI register offsets and fields for IPA v5.0.
    These are used for the SDX65 SoC.  Increase the maximum channel and
    event ring counts supported by the driver, so those implemented by
    the SDX65 are supported.

According to the root cause, these bit field masks are incorrect and cause misconfiguration when writing command values, leading to a WARN during shutdown. No fix is present in this commit.

    Signed-off-by:
bic_trace_step.reason: The `reg_generic_cmd_fmask` array defines bit masks for the GENERIC_CMD register. The definitions for GENERIC_CHID and GENERIC_EE are incorrect for IPA v5.0+: GENERIC_CHID uses GENMASK(9, 5) (bits 5-9, 5 bits) but should be GENMASK(10, 5) (bits 5-10, 6 bits); GENERIC_EE uses GENMASK(13, 10) (bits 10-13, 4 bits) but should be GENMASK(13, 11) (bits 11-13, 3 bits). These wrong masks lead to misconfiguration when writing command values, causing a WARN during shutdown. No fix is present as this is the initial introduction of the v5.0 register definitions.
